ai_summary: This document is a routine compliance filing by Ajooni Biotech Limited, confirming adherence to SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company's Registrar and Transfer Agent, Cameo Corporate Services, verified that all dematerialization requests were processed, listed, and physical certificates mutilated within stipulated timelines. This indicates sound operational compliance and transparency in managing shareholder records, with no material impacts or red flags identified.
